source_refs.note: Topic 2.4.2.1 while Loop (PDF 44, printed 41). Long question 6 prints 'between 1 and Also' (the upper limit is missing); the class activity's limit 20 is used. Recorded.

blocks.title: while loop
blocks.text: A while loop runs as long as its condition is true; it checks the condition before each pass and stops when the condition becomes false.
The number starts at 1; while it is less than 10 the loop prints it and adds 1. It prints 1 to 9 and stops when number reaches 10.

blocks.prompt: Write a while loop that prints the odd numbers from 1 to 20 and counts them (long question 6; class activity).
blocks.explanation: n = 1; count = 0; while n <= 20: if n % 2 == 1: print(n); count += 1 (inside the if); n += 1 (inside the loop); finally print("Total odd numbers:", count), which prints 10.

items: while repeats as long as the condition is true; remember to change the variable or the loop never ends.
